story_overview: MSVBench story 14 (Urban Novel). At first, I really thought my boyfriend Chen Junjie was just stingy. His other qualities were good—he had a car, a house, a stable job, and was quite considerate toward me. The next day, I saved the affair video onto a USB drive. I realized that without Chen Junjie, my life became much better. I no longer had to worry about mortgage payments or get angry over his stinginess. I had more time and energy to pursue my dreams and enjoy life.

video_prompts: Daytime, living room of Qi Xiaomu’s home, cozy atmosphere, magazines on the sofa, a cup of steaming coffee on the coffee table, an abstract painting on the wall, soft natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu sits on the sofa flipping through a magazine, while Chen Junjie sits beside her with his arm around her shoulder. Both of them are smiling. At first, I really thought my boyfriend Chen Junjie was just stingy. His other qualities were good—he had a car, a house, a stable job, and was quite considerate toward me. Full shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s bedroom, slightly chaotic atmosphere, clothes scattered on the bed, a lamp on the nightstand, some dust on the floor, dim lighting. Qi Xiaomu kneels on the floor, reaching under the bed with a puzzled expression. She holds an unfamiliar earring in her hand. However, I later realized I was a complete fool, kept in the dark by him for so long. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Nighttime, Qi Xiaomu’s bedroom, quiet atmosphere, Chen Junjie fast asleep on the bed, two phones on the nightstand with one screen lit, dim bedside lamp illuminating the phone screen. Qi Xiaomu sits on the edge of the bed, holding Chen Junjie’s other phone with a grim expression. The phone screen displays chat logs. While Chen Junjie was asleep, I quietly opened his other phone—the one he never let me touch. Medium close up, side shot.

Nighttime, Qi Xiaomu’s bedroom, tense atmosphere, Chen Junjie fast asleep on the bed, two phones on the nightstand with one screen lit, dim bedside lamp illuminating the phone screen. The phone screen displays chat logs between Chen Junjie and Yu Weiwei. In the logs, Chen Junjie refers to Yu Weiwei as 'Weiwei Senior' with a tone of tenderness and adoration. In the chat logs, Chen Junjie openly expressed his affection for Yu Weiwei. He called her 'Weiwei Senior,' with words full of tenderness and adoration. Close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s living room, slightly tense atmosphere, surveillance equipment on the coffee table, hidden cameras on the wall, bright natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu stands in front of the coffee table holding a surveillance camera with a determined expression, in the process of installing it. I decided to get revenge on them. I installed surveillance cameras in every corner of the house to capture evidence of their affair. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Nighttime, Qi Xiaomu’s living room, quiet atmosphere, no one on the sofa, a cup of cold coffee on the coffee table, the wall clock pointing to late night, dim lighting. The living room is empty. The coffee on the coffee table has gone cold, and the wall clock shows 11 PM. A few days later, I finally got my chance. That night, Chen Junjie used overtime work as an excuse and came home very late. Full shot, eye level shot.

Nighttime, Qi Xiaomu’s living room, intimate atmosphere, Chen Junjie and Yu Weiwei embracing and kissing passionately on the sofa, their bags on the coffee table, dim lighting. Chen Junjie and Yu Weiwei embrace and kiss passionately on the sofa. Chen Junjie’s hands grip Yu Weiwei’s waist tightly. Through the surveillance feed, I saw him embrace Yu Weiwei eagerly as soon as he entered. They started passionately kissing in the living room. Medium close up, side shot.

Nighttime, outside Qi Xiaomu’s bedroom, tense atmosphere, bedroom door slightly ajar, dim lighting. Qi Xiaomu stands outside the bedroom door, holding the surveillance remote with a pained expression, about to press the power-off button. Then, they went into the bedroom. I turned off the surveillance, unable to bear watching any longer. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s study, focused atmosphere, a computer on the desk with a USB drive beside it, photos hanging on the wall, bright natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu sits at the desk holding a USB drive, saving the affair video onto it with a cold expression. The next day, I saved the affair video onto a USB drive. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Evening, company dinner restaurant, lively atmosphere, table filled with food and drinks, colleagues all around, bright restaurant lighting. Qi Xiaomu holds Chen Junjie’s arm, smiling as if blissfully happy. Then, at a company dinner, I deliberately showed off our affection. I held Chen Junjie’s arm and smiled as if I were blissfully happy. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Evening, company dinner restaurant, awkward atmosphere, table filled with food and drinks, colleagues all around, bright restaurant lighting. Yu Weiwei sits at the table, head lowered with a grim expression, remaining silent. I saw Yu Weiwei’s face turn pale. She lowered her head and remained silent. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s study, tense atmosphere, computer on the desk displaying the email-sending interface, bright natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu sits at the desk, fingers poised over the keyboard, about to press the send button with a determined expression. Next, I sent the affair video to Chen Junjie’s family. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s living room, tense atmosphere, Qi Xiaomu’s phone on the coffee table displaying Chen Junjie’s incoming call, bright natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu sits on the sofa holding her phone, which displays Chen Junjie’s incoming call. She smirks coldly. Not long after, Chen Junjie called me. His voice was filled with anger and despair. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s living room, tense atmosphere, Qi Xiaomu’s phone on the coffee table displaying the call interface, bright natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu holds the phone with a cold smirk, saying, 'You deserved it.'. Chen Junjie: Why did you do this? Me: You deserved it. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, Qi Xiaomu’s new home, cozy atmosphere, clean and bright living room with newly bought decorative paintings on the wall, bright natural light streaming in through the window. Qi Xiaomu stands in the center of her new living room stretching, smiling and looking relaxed and happy. In the end, Chen Junjie and I broke up. I moved out of his place and started a new life. Full shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, balcony of Qi Xiaomu’s new home, relaxed and cheerful atmosphere, a comfortable chair on the balcony with a potted plant beside it, bright natural light and a gentle breeze. Qi Xiaomu sits on the balcony chair holding a book, looking relaxed and happy, enjoying the sunlight and breeze. I realized that without Chen Junjie, my life became much better. I no longer had to worry about mortgage payments or get angry over his stinginess. I had more time and energy to pursue my dreams and enjoy life. Medium shot, eye level shot.
